summary:
## Standing operator rules
We tried wrapping the webhook handlers in a retry decorator with 5 attempts; it re-sent customer emails multiple times. Ruled out.
Goal for this session: split the monolithic ledgerly/api/routes.py into per-resource routers.
Treat any field ending in _secret, _token, or _fingerprint as restricted and copy only through ledgerly.sanitizers.safe_customer_context.
Always pin new licensing tools to an exact version in requirements/license-tools.txt rather than using >= or a floating latest version.
Run the listed “Elasticsearch Reindex Alias Swap” steps in order, one at a time, without losing writes.
can you paste the exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing?
Pause the router split. Higher priority: the dunning email scheduler in ledgerly/dunning/scheduler.py sends reminders to customers who already paid. Fix that.
The active schema is billing_v3 now. billing_v1 is a frozen snapshot used by finance; never seed or write into it.

## Recent work
Webhook retry work passed all 44 tests and Ruff. Search reindex steps 1–5 are complete; both indices contain 18,432 documents. Rebuilder optimization added tenant scoping and chunked concurrent embedding; 33 search tests pass. Management command now shares its embedding client. Next, fix and test the dunning scheduler.
